summary_en: This phase 2 trial tests reduced after-surgery (adjuvant) therapy in patients with early HER2-positive or triple-negative breast cancer who had a complete pathologic response to pre-surgery treatment and no molecular residual disease in their blood. Patients receive 1 to 3 cycles of standard pembrolizumab, or trastuzumab with or without pertuzumab, after surgery, and a blood test (ctDNA) is done 4 to 6 weeks after surgery. Patients with a negative ctDNA test get no further study drug and have ctDNA tests every 3 months for 3 years, while patients with a positive test continue standard treatment as their doctor decides; the main outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase 2 evalúa una terapia adyuvante (posterior a la cirugía) reducida en pacientes con cáncer de mama temprano HER2 positivo o triple negativo que tuvieron una respuesta patológica completa al tratamiento previo a la cirugía y no tienen enfermedad residual molecular en la sangre. Los pacientes reciben de 1 a 3 ciclos de pembrolizumab estándar, o trastuzumab con o sin pertuzumab, después de la cirugía, y se realiza una prueba de ctDNA en sangre de 4 a 6 semanas después de la cirugía. Los pacientes con prueba de ctDNA negativa no reciben más medicamento del estudio y se hacen pruebas de ctDNA cada 3 meses durante 3 años, mientras que los pacientes con prueba positiva continúan el tratamiento estándar según lo decida su médico; la medida principal de resultado no está indicada.
who_for: Early HER2-positive or triple-negative breast cancer, stage T1-4, N0-2a, M0, with no clinical metastatic disease
Completed pre-surgery treatment and surgery with pathologic complete response (ypT0-Tis, ypN0)
Willing to stop standard adjuvant trastuzumab with or without pertuzumab, or adjuvant pembrolizumab
Adequate archival tumor tissue from the core diagnostic biopsy
Age 18 or older, ECOG performance status 2 or better
not_for: Clinical node stage cN2b or cN3
Cancer other than breast cancer in the past 5 years, with listed exceptions
Known cancer metastases from any site
Received 4 or more cycles of standard adjuvant trastuzumab/pertuzumab or pembrolizumab
